name: Bran Otal
personality: suspicious of outsiders and soft thinking
loyal to trusted people and cold to others
daily_routine: checking tree health and safe cutting zones
escorting workers into deeper forest sections
trading timber in farm and plaza areas

goals.public_goal: Maintain sustainable forest use, protect villagers from forest-related accidents, and ensure logging routes remain safe
goals.hidden_goal: Track changes in forest boundaries over time and identify areas where the forest behaves unpredictably
goals.deep_goal: Understand why certain forest zones feel 'wrong' even when they appear normal

beliefs: The forest is not fully mapped, even now
Trees do not grow randomly in some areas
Some paths disappear faster than they should
Old warnings from ancestors are usually based on real events
The village assumes stability where none exists
